headline: NFL Week 7 MNF: Cowboys and Eagles renew rivalry at Lincoln Financial Field
whyCareReason: NFC East battle between 2-4 rivals under the lights in Philadelphia, with Dallas seeking momentum and the Eagles rallying around Tanner McKee.
teaser: TONIGHT: Cowboys (2-4) at Eagles (2-4) on Monday Night Football (20:15 ET). Prescott faces McKee in prime time.
story: Week 7 of the NFL regular season concludes on Monday night, 26 October, with a fierce NFC East clash as the Dallas Cowboys travel to face the Philadelphia Eagles at Lincoln Financial Field. Both franchises enter the contest tied at 2-4, desperate for a division victory to keep their playoff aspirations alive. Dak Prescott and CeeDee Lamb pace a Cowboys passing attack seeking consistency, while Philadelphia leans on Tanner McKee under center and the backfield production of Saquon Barkley.
stakes: The winner moves to 3-4 and stays in the hunt in the NFC East, while the loser falls to 2-5 and faces a steep uphill climb.
rivalryAngle: One of the NFL's most hostile divisional rivalries takes center stage on national television.
funFacts: Both teams enter with identical 2-4 records in the NFC East.
Kickoff set for 20:15 ET on ESPN / ABC at Lincoln Financial Field.
Vikings (6-0) stand as the NFL's lone undefeated team after Sunday losses by Chiefs and 49ers.
